latest_audits.grade: B+ overall; official harness/data artifact A-; action-level numerical support B+; independent same-protocol replication C/not located; exact-reconstruction claim C
latest_audits.result: The official repository and released dataset provide strong branching-rollout code, configs, six per-run divergence artifacts and analysis machinery. However the published 99.99% prefix-fidelity / 707-of-708 exact-reconstruction statement is implemented as equality of replayed versus recorded action return codes only. The public fidelity code does not compare observation text, filesystem/repository state or other environment state, and a local criterion counterexample confirmed that identical return codes can coexist with changed state. Downstream wording should therefore say 707/708 branches had no observed comparable return-code mismatch unless stronger state-equivalence evidence appears; this scope correction does not by itself contradict the paper's action-divergence findings.
